Baidyanath (Shree Baidyanath Ayurved Bhawan Pvt. Ltd.) is one of India’s oldest and most trusted Ayurvedic healthcare and FMCG brands , built on over a century of Ayurvedic expertise and authentic traditional formulations. Established in 1917 , the company combines ancient Ayurvedic wisdom with modern scientific practices to create natural, effective, and high-quality herbal medicines, health supplements, and wellness products. Baidyanath offers a wide range of products that include classical Ayurvedic medicines, herbal tonics, immunity boosters, detox solutions, digestive care formulations, oils, powders, and more — all rooted in traditional herbal knowledge and manufactured under stringent quality and GMP standards. The brand’s offerings are trusted by millions of consumers in India and exported to several international markets. With 14 GMP-certified manufacturing units and more than 700 proven formulations , Baidyanath is known for its quality, authenticity, and commitment to holistic wellness. The company continues to innovate while preserving the essence of Ayurveda, ensuring its products support modern lifestyles and health needs. The company aims to roll out 70-75 products this year and has established exclusive retail stores, with the first one opening in New Delhi. Baidyanath has also targeted the US market, partnering with large American distributors and planning to have its products available in around 8,000 retail stores by the end of the year. The company plans to enter 10 to 12 countries in the next six months.
